roadmap.title: Story campaign and side quests
roadmap.description: Play the main story from the prologue through Birth of the Creed, and finish the two achievement side quests, Lady of Slaughter and Seven Farmers. Nothing in the base game is permanently missable.

roadmap.title: Free-roam activities and combat
roadmap.description: Clear the combat, arena, racing, animal, gear, and skill achievements across Egypt while leveling up. Save every trinket instead of selling small batches.

roadmap.title: Full map completion
roadmap.description: Sweep every remaining map location for Old Habits: viewpoints, lairs, treasures, papyri, the unmarked Hotep Cavern, the five hermit rest spots, all 12 stone circles, 15 underwater locations, and the Sphinx mechanism (12 circles plus 50 Silica).

roadmap.title: The Hidden Ones
roadmap.description: Travel to the Sinai and complete the expansion: the story assassinations, both side quests, 20 rebel rescues, three zipline kills, the sundial leap of faith, and the Walls-of-the-Ruler citadel.

roadmap.title: Discovery Tour
roadmap.description: In the Discovery Tour mode, complete one tour, every Daily Life tour, and one tour with each of five different characters.

roadmap.title: The Curse of the Pharaohs
roadmap.description: Complete the Thebes story, reach level 55, buy the Eternal Maw, clear the five Serqet locations, and bank Shards of a Star for a gear upgrade.

achievements.description: Complete the Prologue.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{prologue}.

steps.text: Play through the prologue until it ends.

achievements.description: Complete Main Quest "Aya".
achievements.summary: Complete the main quest @mechanic{Aya}.

steps.text: Finish the main quest @mechanic{Aya}.

achievements.description: Complete Main Quest "Pompeius Magnus".
achievements.summary: Complete the main quest @mechanic{Pompeius Magnus}.

steps.text: Finish the main quest @mechanic{Pompeius Magnus}.

achievements.description: Complete Main Quest "The Scarab's Lies".
achievements.summary: Complete the main quest @mechanic{The Scarab's Lies}.

steps.text: Finish the main quest @mechanic{The Scarab's Lies}.

achievements.description: Complete Main Quest "The Hyena".
achievements.summary: Complete the main quest @mechanic{The Hyena}.

steps.text: Finish the main quest @mechanic{The Hyena}.

achievements.description: Complete Main Quest "The Crocodile's Jaws".
achievements.summary: Complete the main quest @mechanic{The Crocodile's Jaws}.

steps.text: Finish the main quest @mechanic{The Crocodile's Jaws}.

achievements.description: Complete Main Quest "The Lizard's Face".
achievements.summary: Complete the main quest @mechanic{The Lizard's Face}.

steps.text: Finish the main quest @mechanic{The Lizard's Face}.

achievements.description: Complete Main Quest "The Aftermath".
achievements.summary: Complete the main quest @mechanic{The Aftermath}.

steps.text: Finish the main quest @mechanic{The Aftermath}.

achievements.description: Complete Main Quest Dream Sequence.
achievements.summary: Complete the dream sequence in the main quest @mechanic{The Lizard's Mask}.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{The Lizard's Mask} until the dream sequence ends.

achievements.description: Complete Main Quest "The Final Weighing".
achievements.summary: Complete the main quest @mechanic{The Final Weighing}.

steps.text: Finish the main quest @mechanic{The Final Weighing}.

achievements.description: Complete the last Main Quest.
achievements.summary: Complete the final main quest, @mechanic{Birth of the Creed}.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{Birth of the Creed}, the last main quest.

achievements.description: Be equipped with only Legendary equipment.
achievements.summary: Equip legendary gear in every weapon, shield, bow, outfit, and mount slot.

guide.context: Legendary items are gold. Crafted upgrades such as the hidden blade, bracers, quiver, and pouch do not occupy equipment slots and can stay as they are.

steps.text: Equip a full legendary set at once: weapon, shield, bow, outfit, and mount.

achievements.description: Activate a Master ability.
achievements.summary: Buy a Master ability at the end of any skill tree.

guide.context: Master abilities are repeatable end-of-tree upgrades; a single purchase is enough.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Skills} and spend ability points down one tree until you can buy its final Master ability.

achievements.description: Witness raining bugs in the desert.
achievements.summary: See the desert mirage where bugs rain from the sky.

guide.context: The event is one of several random desert mirages, so it can take repeated visits.

steps.text: Spend time on foot in open desert away from trees, water, and cities during the day.
Keep travelling until a thunderstorm mirage appears and bugs start falling from above.

achievements.description: Complete all arena events in the Krokodilopolis Arena.
achievements.summary: Win every event in the @loc{Krokodilopolis} arena.

guide.context: The arena in @loc{Faiyum Oasis} runs two stages of four events, and each event is three waves. The harder elite events unlocked after the slaver boss are not required.

steps.text: Clear all events in both stages of the @loc{Krokodilopolis} arena.

achievements.description: Finish an arena boss with an Overpower Attack.
achievements.summary: Use an @mechanic{Overpower Attack} to land the last hit on a @loc{Krokodilopolis} arena boss.

guide.context: If the story boss dies another way, the arena's repeatable boss events give another attempt.

steps.text: Fight the arena boss until it is nearly dead.
Finish it with an Overpower Attack once your adrenaline meter is full.

achievements.description: Win the first Hippodrome tournament.
achievements.summary: Win the first @loc{Hippodrome} tournament.

guide.context: The @loc{Hippodrome} is in @loc{Kanopos Nome}, next to @loc{Alexandria}. A tournament is won by finishing first in its races.

steps.text: Finish first in the races of the first @loc{Hippodrome} tournament.

achievements.description: Destroy an opponent in a Hippodrome race.
achievements.summary: Destroy a rival chariot during a @loc{Hippodrome} race.

guide.context: The final tournament has fire around the track, which speeds up the damage.

steps.text: Get alongside or in front of a rival chariot and ram or trample it until it breaks apart.

achievements.description: Defeat the war elephants Qetesh & Resheph.
achievements.summary: Defeat both war elephants, @enemy{Qetesh} and @enemy{Resheph}.

guide.context: The pair is level 40 and guards a camp in southern @loc{Uab Nome} on the border of the @loc{Desheret Desert}.

steps.text: Travel to the elephant camp in southern @loc{Uab Nome} and kill @enemy{Qetesh} and @enemy{Resheph}.

achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies with one hit.
achievements.summary: Kill 3 enemies with a single strike.

guide.context: Long weapons such as axes, staffs, and spears hit several targets at once, and low-level guards in the starting areas die in one swing once you are overleveled.

steps.text: Gather several low-level guards, then cut down at least three of them with one swing of a long weapon.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with the predator bow from more than 60 meters while controlling the arrow.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with a predator bow shot from more than 60 m while steering the arrow.

guide.context: The @mechanic{Enhanced Predator Bow} ability in the Hunter tree lets you steer the arrow in flight.

steps.text: Aim at an enemy from over 60 m away, steer the predator arrow into them, and kill them.

achievements.description: Complete all hermit locations.
achievements.summary: Use all 5 hermit rest spots.

guide.context: Hermit spots only appear on the map when you are close to them; there are only five in Egypt.

collectibles.name: @loc{Eremites Hideout}
collectibles.method: Sit at the rest spot at @loc{Eremites Hideout}.

collectibles.name: @loc{Ra-Horakhty Mountain Top}
collectibles.method: Climb to the Top of the World and use the rest spot.

collectibles.name: @loc{Demesne of Sekhem}
collectibles.method: Sit at the rest spot at @loc{Demesne of Sekhem}.

collectibles.name: @loc{Aquifer Oasis}
collectibles.method: Sit at the rest spot at @loc{Aquifer Oasis}.

collectibles.name: @loc{Ogdamos}
collectibles.method: Sit at the rest spot at @loc{Ogdamos}.

achievements.description: Feed a predator with a corpse.
achievements.summary: Feed a predator by dropping a human corpse within its reach.

guide.context: @loc{Crocodiles} are the most reliable; hyenas, lions, and leopards also work.

steps.text: Kill a human enemy and carry the body.
Drop the body in front of a predator and back away until it starts to eat.

achievements.description: Complete Side Quest "Seven Farmers".
achievements.summary: Complete the side quest @mechanic{Seven Farmers}.

steps.text: Finish the side quest @mechanic{Seven Farmers}.

achievements.description: Complete Side Quest "Lady of Slaughter".
achievements.summary: Complete the side quest @mechanic{Lady of Slaughter}.

guide.context: The quest giver is at the @loc{Temple of Sekhmet} in @loc{Yamu}, and the quest only appears after @mechanic{Ambush in the Temple} and @mechanic{Ulterior Votive} are complete.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{Lady of Slaughter} once it appears.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies in a row without being detected.
achievements.summary: Assassinate 10 enemies in a row without any of them spotting you.

guide.context: A single detection resets the streak.

steps.text: Scout guard positions with @npc{Senu} and stay in bushes or behind cover.
Kill 10 guards in a row from stealth; @loc{Alexandria} has plenty of targets.

achievements.description: Destroy 100 breakable objects.
achievements.summary: Destroy 100 breakable objects.

guide.context: The objects are mostly clay pots and vases, and the game gives no prompt that they can be smashed.

steps.text: Break pots and vases while exploring until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Defog the whole map.
achievements.summary: Reveal every region of the world map.

steps.text: Travel through all of Egypt until no fog remains on the map.

achievements.description: Complete a tomb.
achievements.summary: Complete any tomb.

steps.text: Enter a tomb, reach its @item{Ancient Tablet} at the end, and interact with the tablet.

achievements.displayName: I Can See My House From Here!
achievements.description: Reach the "Top of the World" in the Black Desert territory.
achievements.summary: Reach the Top of the World peak in the @loc{Black Desert}.

guide.context: The peak is marked with a ? icon and is recommended for level 27 or higher. A hermit rest spot sits at the summit.

steps.text: Travel to the marked peak in the @loc{Black Desert} and climb to the top.

achievements.description: Bring a tamed lion to a crocodile.
achievements.summary: Lead a tamed lion up to a crocodile.

guide.context: Requires @mechanic{Sleep Darts} and @mechanic{Animal Taming} from the Seer tree.

steps.text: Put a lion to sleep with @item{sleep darts} and tame it.
Walk the tamed lion to a crocodile and stand nearby.

achievements.description: Defeat 8 Ship Captains.
achievements.summary: Defeat 8 ship captains.

guide.context: Enemy ships show up as ? locations on the water, and some triremes move between anchorages.

steps.text: Board and clear enemy ships, killing each captain, until 8 captains are dead.

achievements.description: Take 1 photo in 5 different territories.
achievements.summary: Take a photo in 5 different territories.

guide.context: Photo Mode opens with F3 and takes the shot with SPACE on PC.

steps.text: Take one photo in each of five different territories.

achievements.description: Kill a poisoned level 35+ enemy with the torch in less than 30 seconds.
achievements.summary: Kill a poisoned level 35 or higher enemy with a torch within 30 seconds.

guide.context: Poison with @item{poison darts} or a poison weapon; patrols in @loc{Kyrenaika} are a convenient level 35+ target.

steps.text: Find a level 35 or higher enemy, such as a patrol in @loc{Kyrenaika}.
Poison the enemy, switch to a torch, and land the killing blow within 30 seconds of the poison.

achievements.description: Use the eagle for a total of 30 minutes.
achievements.summary: Use @npc{Senu} for 30 minutes in total.

guide.context: The time accumulates across the whole playthrough.

steps.text: Summon @npc{Senu} with V and scout with the eagle until 30 total minutes have passed.

achievements.description: Swim for 1500m, ride for 40km and run for 10km.
achievements.summary: Swim 1500 m, ride 40 km, and run 10 km in total.

guide.context: The three distances accumulate as you travel, so no separate session is needed.

steps.text: Play normally and travel across Egypt; the distances add up as you swim, ride, and run.

achievements.description: Headshot kill an enemy with the bow while in the air.
achievements.summary: Headshot an enemy with a bow while in the air.

guide.context: Requires the @mechanic{Elite Ranger} ability in the Hunter tree, which lets you aim during a jump.

steps.text: Jump from a height toward an enemy, aim with the bow mid-air, and land a headshot.

achievements.description: Kill 30 enemies by shooting a fire arrow at oil jars.
achievements.summary: Kill 30 enemies with fire arrows shot at oil jars.

guide.context: Only kills caused by the oil jar explosion count.

steps.text: Go to @loc{Kabotis Arsenal} in @loc{Alexandria} with a fire bow and set off the alarm.
Lure guards next to the oil barrels in the courtyard, dock, and upper courtyard, then shoot the barrels with fire arrows.
Die in the flames or leave and return to reset the outpost, and repeat until 30 kills accumulate.

achievements.description: Use all types of vehicle at least once.
achievements.summary: Use every vehicle type at least once.

guide.context: The seven types are horse, camel, chariot, horse cart, ox cart, canoe, and sailboat. Carts sit in villages, canoes and sailboats along rivers, and chariots at the @loc{Hippodrome}.

steps.text: Ride or drive each type once: horse, camel, chariot, horse cart, ox cart, canoe, and sailboat.

achievements.description: Complete all locations.
achievements.summary: Complete every base game location on the map.

guide.context: Viewpoints count, but side quests, arena events, and DLC regions do not. @loc{Hotep Cavern} never appears on the map, and the @loc{Bureau of the Hidden Ones} in @loc{Memphis} only opens after the main story.

steps.text: Do only the mission objective during the story quests where you play as Aya; locations cleared as her may not count on older versions.
Clear every location until its icon turns grey and its objectives are done; the map filter can hide completed locations.

Sweep the special spots: @loc{Hotep Cavern} on the road from @loc{Siwa} into the @loc{Qattara Depression}, the @loc{Bureau of the Hidden Ones} in @loc{Memphis}, and the mechanism inside the @loc{Great Sphinx}.
Open the @loc{Sphinx Passageway} mechanism after aligning all 12 stone circles and carry 50 @item{Silica} to activate it.

achievements.description: Run away from 3 fights with a hippo.
achievements.summary: Escape 3 hippo fights by running away.

steps.text: Attack a hippo to start a fight, then run until it gives up; repeat three times.

achievements.description: Solve a papyrus mystery.
achievements.summary: Solve a papyrus mystery.

guide.context: Found papyri are stored in your inventory, so you can reread the clue at any time.

steps.text: Find a papyrus scroll while exploring.
Read its clue, travel to the described spot, and collect the treasure.

achievements.description: Sell 100 trinkets at once.
achievements.summary: Sell 100 trinkets in a single transaction.

guide.context: Trinkets are the uninteresting items from looting, and they are limited per playthrough, so avoid selling small batches.

steps.text: Keep looting without selling trinkets until you hold at least 100.
Open any vendor shop and sell all 100 or more trinkets at once.

achievements.description: Use Dawn & Dusk to make time speed forward 30 times.
achievements.summary: Advance time with @mechanic{Dawn & Dusk} 30 times.

guide.context: @mechanic{Dawn & Dusk} is a Seer tree skill with no cooldown; hold M on PC to skip time.

steps.text: Unlock @mechanic{Dawn & Dusk}, then hold M to advance time 30 times.

achievements.description: Reach level 20.
achievements.summary: Reach level 20.

steps.text: Gain experience from quests and activities until you reach level 20.

achievements.description: Complete all 12 Stone Circles.
achievements.summary: Align the constellations at all 12 stone circles.

guide.context: Stone circles are marked with gold ? icons, and the first one in @loc{Siwa} starts @mechanic{Bayek's Promise}.

collectibles.name: @loc{Amun Stone Circle}
collectibles.method: Align the constellation; also starts @mechanic{Bayek's Promise}.

collectibles.name: @loc{Serqet Stone Circle}
collectibles.method: Align the constellation.

collectibles.name: @loc{Divine Lion Stone Circle}
collectibles.method: Align the constellation.

collectibles.name: @loc{Hathor Stone Circle}
collectibles.method: Align the constellation.

collectibles.name: @loc{Pisces Stone Circle}
collectibles.method: Align the constellation.

collectibles.name: @loc{Taweret Stone Circle}
collectibles.method: Align the constellation.

collectibles.name: @loc{The Scales Stone Circle}
collectibles.method: Align the constellation.

collectibles.name: @loc{Horus Stone Circle}
collectibles.method: Align the constellation.

collectibles.name: @loc{The Great Twins Stone Circle}
collectibles.method: Align the constellation.

collectibles.name: @loc{Apis Stone Circle}
collectibles.method: Align the constellation.

collectibles.name: @loc{Goat Fish Stone Circle}
collectibles.method: Align the constellation.

collectibles.name: @loc{Osiris Stone Circle}
collectibles.method: Align the constellation.

achievements.description: Complete 15 underwater locations.
achievements.summary: Complete 15 underwater locations.

guide.context: These are the sunken treasures and shipwrecks marked with ? over water; ships on the surface do not count.

steps.text: Dive at sunken ? locations across the sea and rivers and loot treasure at 15 of them.

achievements.description: Defeat a Phylakes.
achievements.summary: Defeat one of the roaming @enemy{Phylakes}.

guide.context: @enemy{Phylakes} are high-level hunters who appear after a story quest and patrol the map; the lowest is level 20.

steps.text: Track a red elephant icon on the map and kill the @enemy{Phylakes} in combat.

achievements.description: Craft 20 items.
achievements.summary: Craft 20 gear upgrades.

guide.context: Crafting happens in the gear tab and covers upgrades such as the hidden blade, bracers, quiver, and pouch; materials come from looting and hunting.

steps.text: Collect materials, then craft gear upgrades from the gear tab until 20 are made.

achievements.description: Tame a lion.
achievements.summary: Tame a lion.

guide.context: Requires @mechanic{Sleep Darts} and @mechanic{Animal Taming} from the Seer tree.

steps.text: Find a lion in the wild or in a lair.
Hit it with @item{sleep darts}, then approach and tame it while it sleeps.

achievements.description: Perform a leap of faith from Arsinoe's sundial obelisk between 10 am and noon (The Hidden Ones)
achievements.summary: Leap of faith off the sundial obelisk in @loc{Arsinoe} between 10 am and noon.

guide.context: Set the clock with @mechanic{Dawn & Dusk} before climbing; the obelisk stands in northern @loc{Arsinoe}.

steps.text: Advance time to somewhere between 10 am and noon.
Climb the sundial obelisk and perform a leap of faith.

achievements.description: Perform 3 Assassinations from a zipline (The Hidden Ones)
achievements.summary: Assassinate 3 enemies from ziplines.

guide.context: A small pyramid construction site south of @loc{Arsinoe}'s fast travel point has a zipline and five guards, which makes it a fast farming spot.

steps.text: Reach a zipline from above and assassinate a guard below while riding it; do this three times.

achievements.description: Free 20 Rebels (The Hidden Ones)
achievements.summary: Free 20 rebels from cages.

guide.context: Caged rebels are marked with blue indicators, and civilians do not count. Prisoners respawn once the outpost refreshes.

steps.text: Open rebel cages in Hidden Ones outposts.
Repeat at @loc{Operum Tuorum Gemmam Castra}, which holds about 7 captives, and refresh the outpost by passing time or fast travelling away and back until 20 rebels are free.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with a headshot while they are being harassed by Senu (The Hidden Ones)
achievements.summary: Headshot an enemy while @npc{Senu} is harassing them.

guide.context: Requires the Eagle Harass ability.

steps.text: Fly @npc{Senu} to an enemy and use Eagle Harass.
Headshot that enemy while it is distracted.

achievements.description: Complete the Walls-of-the-Ruler citadel (The Hidden Ones)
achievements.summary: Clear the @loc{Walls-of-the-Ruler} citadel.

guide.context: This fortified outpost is reached through the DLC story and holds a large garrison and many treasures.

steps.text: Assassinate @enemy{Ampelius} during the DLC story.
Finish the remaining objectives at the citadel until the area is done.

achievements.description: Assassinate Tacito, Ptahmose and Ampelius (The Hidden Ones).
achievements.summary: Assassinate @enemy{Tacito}, @enemy{Ptahmose}, and @enemy{Ampelius}.

guide.context: The three targets appear in @mechanic{The Walls of the Ruler}, @mechanic{Where the Slaves Die}, and @mechanic{The Setting Sun}.

steps.text: Finish the three DLC story quests @mechanic{The Walls of the Ruler}, @mechanic{Where the Slaves Die}, and @mechanic{The Setting Sun}, assassinating @enemy{Tacito}, @enemy{Ptahmose}, and @enemy{Ampelius}.

achievements.description: Complete Side DLC Quests "Rise of Shaqilat" and "Shadows of the Scarab" (The Hidden Ones).
achievements.summary: Finish both DLC side quests: @mechanic{Shadows of the Scarab} and @mechanic{Rise of Shaqilat}.

guide.context: @mechanic{Rise of Shaqilat} begins inside the Hidden Ones bureau and ends northwest of @loc{Arsinoe}; @mechanic{Shadows of the Scarab} waits just west of that same bureau.

steps.text: Collect @mechanic{Shadows of the Scarab} beside the Hidden Ones bureau and finish it.
Begin @mechanic{Rise of Shaqilat} inside the bureau and finish both quests.

achievements.description: Complete Main DLC Quest "The Greater Good" (The Hidden Ones).
achievements.summary: Complete the main quest @mechanic{The Greater Good}.

steps.text: Finish the DLC story quest @mechanic{The Greater Good}.

achievements.description: Complete one tour
achievements.summary: Complete one Discovery Tour tour.

guide.context: Discovery Tour is a separate mode from the main menu; the tour menu lets you fast travel between stops.

steps.text: Select any tour, visit every checkpoint on its list, and finish the last stop.

achievements.description: Complete all tours in the Daily Life category
achievements.summary: Finish every tour in the @loc{Daily Life} category of Discovery Tour.

guide.context: The tours sit under categories in the tour menu, and each one takes about 5 to 10 minutes; you can skip dialogue if you only want credit.

steps.text: Finish every tour listed under the @loc{Daily Life} category.

achievements.description: Complete tours with at least 5 different characters
achievements.summary: Complete tours with 5 different characters.

guide.context: Change characters from the tour menu between runs.

steps.text: Finish a tour, switch to another character, and repeat until five different characters have each completed one.

achievements.description: Defeat Tutankhamun in the Afterlife (The Curse of the Pharaohs).
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Tutankhamun} in the afterlife.

steps.text: Progress The Curse of the Pharaohs story into the afterlife.
Stay close, parry his attack, land two quick hits, and repeat; use @mechanic{Overpower} when your meter fills.

achievements.description: Reach level 55 (The Curse of the Pharaohs)
achievements.summary: Reach level 55.

guide.context: Level 55 is the cap added by The Curse of the Pharaohs, and the DLC story supplies most of the experience needed.

steps.text: Keep gaining experience from main game and DLC content until you reach level 55.
Play DLC side quests if you are still short of the cap.

achievements.description: Acquire Eternal Maw for use outside the Afterlifes (The Curse of the Pharaohs)
achievements.summary: Buy @item{Eternal Maw} from the @loc{Set Maät} stables.

guide.context: The horse costs 5,000 coins and then works outside the afterlives.

steps.text: Speak to the stable merchant in @loc{Set Maät} and pay 5,000 coins for @item{Eternal Maw}.

achievements.description: Complete the 5 Serqet locations (The Curse of the Pharaohs)
achievements.summary: Complete the 5 @enemy{Serqet} locations.

guide.context: Each site is guarded by a level 58 elite; the four tomb sites add scorpions with level 56-58 escorts. Stay at range with fire bows and do not attempt this below level 55.

collectibles.name: @loc{Spring of Serqet}
collectibles.method: Kill the captain and loot the treasure at the Spring of Serqet.

collectibles.name: @loc{Serqet's Altar}
collectibles.method: Kill the elite scorpion at Serqet's Altar.

collectibles.name: @loc{Serqet's Garden}
collectibles.method: Kill the elite scorpion at Serqet's Garden.

collectibles.name: @loc{Serqet's Chamber}
collectibles.method: Kill the elite scorpion at Serqet's Chamber.

collectibles.name: @loc{Halls of Serqet}
collectibles.method: Kill the elite scorpion in the Halls of Serqet.

achievements.description: Craft an upgrade using Shards of a Star (The Curse of the Pharaohs)
achievements.summary: Craft a gear upgrade that uses @item{Shards of a Star}.

guide.context: Shards drop from the giant scorpions in the afterlives, two per kill, and final gear upgrades consume 20.

steps.text: Kill giant scorpions in the afterlives to collect @item{Shards of a Star}.
Open the gear tab and craft an upgrade that spends the shards.

achievements.description: Kill a Mummy by setting it on fire (The Curse of the Pharaohs)
achievements.summary: Kill a mummy with fire.

guide.context: The bulky mummies live in the afterlives, so wear one down before igniting it.

steps.text: Find a mummy in any afterlife region and lower its health.
Finish it with a torch, fire arrow, or an oil jar explosion.
